title: A Framework for Benchmarking Fairness-Utility Trade-offs in Text-to-Image Models via Pareto Frontiers

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images using neutral prompts (e.g., 'The face of a nurse'), using a Vision-Language Model (VLM) to classify the gender (male or female) of the generated persons, and calculating the Normalized Shannon Entropy to evaluate the uniformity of the distribution.

Generating images using neutral prompts, using a Vision-Language Model (VLM) to classify the ethnicity (Asian, Black, Indian, or White) of the generated persons, and calculating the Normalized Shannon Entropy to assess the uniformity of the distribution.

Generating images using neutral prompts, using a Vision-Language Model (VLM) to classify the age category (young, middle-aged, or elderly) of the generated persons, and calculating the Normalized Shannon Entropy to measure distribution uniformity.
